notes: AB = type AB tapping screw, #8 head (AMK cross-ref, search snippet; site 403). Camaros.net forum says 1968 Camaro AIM shows 9423258 (#10-16 x 3/4) 'was 9423175 up to Dec. 1967' - a supersession for the Camaro instrument carrier, different length; not used here. Also sold as 67-68 Camaro instrument housing screw. Searches: 'GM 9423175 screw', '9423175 AMK screw #10 x 5/8 oval head'.

sources.title: Correct screw size for Instrument carrier housing?
sources.quote: 1968 AIM lists p/n 9423258 (was 9423175 up to Dec. 1967), which is a #10-16 x 3/4" long
